integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically from the planar Steiner formulas and the isoperimetric inequality. The packaged checker verifies only the algebra after denominators are cleared; no finite computation is treated as a proof of the geometric theorem.
scientific_limitations: The exact identity is proved only in dimension two and only along Minkowski interpolation toward a Euclidean disk. It does not claim a corresponding exact law for arbitrary pairs or higher dimensions. Direct full-text access to the 2003 Fradelizi--Giannopoulos--Meyer paper was unavailable during this check, leaving a small residual risk of an unindexed earlier occurrence of the closed form.
title: Exact isoperimetric-deficit law for planar information concavity
